title: Sign
body:
Wowee, that's a load of text! This sign supports rich text!


The Sign is a schematic that can be purchased from The Oak Depot or Illumine Designs. It is a block that can show text.

Functionality

Until the schematic is completely filled, the Sign will only display placeholder text that says "Fill me with material to edit text", instructing the user to fill the schematic with a material in order to edit the text. The text on the Sign will always attempt to fill the sign completely to its edges. Once filled, the Sign will be auto-filled with "This is some text!" as a placeholder. A player with the correct permissions can edit the sign, and set the text to whatever they want. Signs support a subset of Roblox's rich text formatting[1].

For details on how to use Rich Text in signs, go to Sign Text Formatting.
